To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) a user interface can be designed that allows users to query biomedical ontologies and knowledge bases in a natural language; (b) a rule layer can be developed over a set of biomedical ontologies and a set of databases, and the rule layer can be queried using a natural language query.

we have developed an interactive natural language interface for querying ontologies and databases that allows users to represent their queries in a natural and understandable way, and to get their answers in a natural language with or without explanations.
we have developed a user interface for querying biomedical ontologies and a rule layer for integrating knowledge in ontologies and databases.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of an integrated system that allows users to query biomedical ontologies using natural language, and presents the answers in a natural language; and that is also able to answer complex questions by integrating relevant knowledge stored in various forms in different locations.
the development of a user interface that allows the user to query biomedical ontologies using natural language, and to present the answers in a natural language.

the development of a user-friendly interface to query biomedical knowledge in natural language, and the development of a knowledge base that allows users to access biomedical knowledge stored in ontologies and databases in a uniform manner.

we have developed an intelligent system that allows users to query biomedical ontologies using natural language.
we have developed a novel approach for querying biomedical ontologies in natural language, and have implemented a system for it.

the work presented in this thesis provides an effective solution to the first challenge by providing an intelligent natural language interface to access biomedical knowledge, and that it addresses the second challenge by providing a novel approach for integrating knowledge from different biomedical ontologies and knowledge bases.

we developed an intelligent user interface, and a rule layer, to facilitate access to biomedical knowledge represented in ontologies, databases and rules.

we have developed an intelligent user interface for answering queries about biomedical ontologies in natural language, and have used Answer Set Programming (ASP) as the main reasoning engine for our system.
